limits: This is a correctness fixture in disposable in-memory SurrealDB, not a production consignment or package schema, throughput result, or populated migration.
The branch is deliberately bounded to two leaf records; unbounded descendant fan-out, contention and operational depth limits remain unmeasured.
The fixture shows one-hop typed shadow propagation for one concrete sales chain; it does not make arbitrary nested dereferences reactive.
Cross-table duplicate-event prevention is not proved by table-local record IDs and remains a separate domain contract.
Independent payment dates and managed tax role removal were covered in the earlier H3a/H3b accounting-core probes rather than duplicated in this isolated ancestry fixture.
